Nora Kim: Flag — customer LumenMetrics reports June invoice embedding total 1.24M but their internal shows ~1.36M (~9% delta). Suspect ingestion gap 2026-06-12T09:40Z-10:10Z. Can eng confirm?

Eli Chen: Checking kafka. Consumer group `metering-processor-v5` had a lag spike and autoscaler churn in that window. I'll run a dry reingest filtered to tenant=lumenmetrics.

Eli Chen: Dry-run command I used:
```
./tools/reingest --topic meter-events --start 4450000 --end 4453600 --filter tenant=lumenmetrics --dry-run
```

Eli Chen: Dry-run delta = +118,540 embed units for lumenmetrics -> est charge +$165.96 (@ $0.0014/unit). Checksums validated, no conflicts.

Zoe Martinez: <$5k so policy allows ledger backfill + next-invoice adjustment. Finance side approves.

Priya Kapoor: Scheduling write in low-traffic maintenance window now. Will monitor offsets and downstream consumers.

billing-bot: NOTE: ledger writes will generate audit events. Ensure `ledger-adjustment:reason=ingest-replay-autoscaler-churn` is set. KB: https://docs.redwood/internal/billing/ledger-adjustments

Eli Chen: Replay/write finished. Audit ID ADJ-2026-11021. Ledger increased by +118,540 embed units for tenant lumenmetrics. Adjustment queued for next invoice.

CSM-Finn: Notified LumenMetrics with standard blurb: we reprocessed a short window of telemetry due to transient autoscaler churn and adjusted your usage ledger by +118,540 embed units; this will appear on your next invoice. Customer prefers next-invoice adjustment.
